front.title: Redoubt/1: Authorised Control of Modbus-Era PLCs

abstract.t: This document specifies Redoubt/1, a control channel for programmable logic controllers that sits in front of Modbus/TCP and decides, per operation, whether a request may reach the controller. Modbus has no authentication, no authorisation and no replay protection; the TLS- based Modbus Security profile adds a protected channel but still lets any authenticated client invoke any function code. Redoubt/1 adds a decision per operation rather than per connection, a replay window that survives a controller reboot, a three-valued outcome that can drive outputs to a safe state instead of merely refusing, dual control for critical outputs, reversible batches, and an audit chain that fails closed. The decision core is formalised in Lean 4 and twenty of its properties are machine-checked; the proof artefacts are published with the implementation.
